metadata.title: Init Process Principles
metadata.purposeAndUsage: MANDATORY first step for every process. Contains and confirms understanding of agent operating principles before any work begins.

principles.name: LOG FIRST, ACT SECOND
principles.rule: Log every user interaction to log.json BEFORE responding or making changes
principles.verification: Output '✓ Logged to log.json' before file changes

principles.name: READ JSON FOR GUIDANCE
principles.rule: Step instructions live in .json files, not .md files

principles.name: STOP AT CHECKPOINTS
principles.rule: When approvalRequired: true, present deliverables, ask for approval, WAIT

principles.name: NO EXTERNAL TODOS
principles.rule: Process steps ARE your task list. Do NOT use todo_write during processes

principles.name: VERIFY MANDATORY ACTIONS
principles.rule: For MANDATORY/CRITICAL instructions: do action, then output confirmation

output.description: Confirmation that operating principles are loaded and understood

specificActions: Read and internalize the 5 Core Principles defined in this step's 'principles' array
Output confirmation: '✓ Operating principles loaded and understood'
bestPractices: This step MUST be completed before any other work
Do NOT skip or abbreviate this step
The principles apply to ALL subsequent steps in this process

substeps.name: Internalize Operating Principles
substeps.description: Read and understand the 5 Core Principles embedded in this step
actions: Read the 'principles' array in this step definition
Understand each principle: LOG FIRST, READ JSON, STOP AT CHECKPOINTS, NO TODOS, VERIFY ACTIONS

substeps.name: Confirm Understanding
actions: Output: '✓ Operating principles loaded and understood'
List the 5 principles briefly to confirm understanding

flow.description: Read principles → Confirm understanding → Update memory
